mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is causally linked to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it increases the cost of capital for corporations and compresses equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a simultaneous contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive central bank policy that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 320.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300, it indicates a contraction in the residential construction sector, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) slows below 159,000 and retail sales (RSAFS) decline below 720,000, it signals a weakening consumer economy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 159000 and RSAFS < 720000.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to prolonged increases in the cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
